task: AquaBlend T3 backlog Task 45: MILP outputs agreement

categories.present: May be shown to users and quoted as a number or value in an explanation.
categories.evidence: May shape the wording of an explanation (e.g. 'at its maximum bound'), but is not shown as a raw value to end users.
categories.technical: Shown only in a technical or diagnostics view, never in the plain-language explanation.
categories.internal: Not presented anywhere. Used only for joins, logging or checks.

gates.rule: Present only fields marked when=always. Do not present any decision, flow, cost, demand-shortfall or quality value. Current code fills these with 0.0 and unmet demand equal to full demand, which would read as a real result.
Treat the same as NO_SOLUTION for presentation, and name the failed checks (validation.output_consistency.checks[] with passed=false) in the technical view.
Fields marked when=valid may be presented according to their category.

schema_version.note: Log it. Code emits '0.1' while the contract says '1.0' (gap G1).

scenario.status.note: Scenario lifecycle status (e.g. 'draft'), not the solver result. Never describe it as the outcome.

scenario.data_source.allow_estimated_val.note: Currently always null (gap G7). Do not claim data is or is not estimated.

validation.loader.checks[].note: Empty list when the loader passes no check detail through.

solver.status.note: Show a friendly label. Code emits raw lowercase Pyomo values ('optimal', 'infeasible'); the contract vocabulary is uppercase (gap G2). Compare case-insensitively.

solver.objective_value.note: Same value as summary.costs.total_cost when valid. Quote one of them, not both.

summary.total_demand_ml_per_day.note: Scenario input, safe to state even with no solution.

summary.costs.total_cost.note: No currency in the contract (gap G11). Do not add 'AUD' or '$' until the PO confirms the unit.

sources[].source_id.note: Output has IDs only (e.g. '225103'). Display names come from ScenarioData, not from this output.

sources[].selection_status.note: Code emits SELECTED / NOT_SELECTED / EXCLUDED; contract says UNUSED instead of NOT_SELECTED (gap G3). EXCLUDED may be presented in any mode because it is decided before solving.

sources[].exclusion_reason_code.note: 'N/A' for included sources (gap G4). Present only when selection_status is EXCLUDED.

sources[].utilisation_percent.note: Percent of the source's maximum withdrawal.

sources[].blend_ratio.display: multiply by 100 and show as a percentage
sources[].blend_ratio.note: Code divides by total delivered across the network, not by the plant's inflow as the contract says (gap G9). Same value while there is one plant.

sources[].decision_evidence.unit_cost_ra.note: Context only. Never write that a source was chosen 'because it is cheapest' (contract section 8.5.3).

demand_zones[].demand_satisfied.note: In NO_SOLUTION mode code sets this to false; that reflects zeroed flows, not a real shortfall.

demand_zones[].unmet_demand_ml_per_day.note: Always 0 for a valid run under hard demand. In NO_SOLUTION mode code reports the full demand here, which must not be presented as a shortfall.

quality.applies_to.note: 'blend_at_plant_inflow': quality is the blended water entering the plant, before any treatment. Never describe it as delivered or treated water quality.

quality.plant_inflow[].parameters[].note: Empty list when the plant has no inflow.

quality.plant_inflow[].parameters[].para.note: Key comes from the scenario ('ph' in base_scenarios_v1, 'pH' in the contract). Match case-insensitively; do not hard-code.

quality.plant_inflow[].parameters[].mode.note: For pH these are hydrogen-ion limits in nmol/L, not pH. Never present them as pH limits (gap G12).
Model-space value (hydrogen-ion for pH). Use reported_value instead.

binding_constraints_summary[].note: Deterministic sentences from postprocessing. Safe to quote; do not add causes to them.

warnings[].note: In NO_SOLUTION mode this contains '... unset by the solver (None); treated as 0.0' entries, which are postprocessing artefacts, not findings.

never_say: That a source was selected because it is the cheapest (unit_cost_rank is context, not cause).
Any treatment, chemical-dosing or contaminant-removal cost: the current objective has four cost terms only (source fixed, source variable, plant fixed, plant variable).
That inflow quality is the quality of delivered or treated water.
A currency for costs until the PO confirms it.
A pH limit taken from model_min/model_max.
Any decision, cost or shortfall figure when the gate mode is NO_SOLUTION or INVALID_OUTPUT.
